purpose: Turn Aider Polyglot / Exercism-style benchmark attempts into signed, schema-complete corpus traces across locked languages.
policy: Aider runs are trace farms, not scoreboard-only runs.
Each attempt emits exactly one signed corpus row.
Verifier-backed pass/fail/reject traces may become active_training_eligible when source gates pass.
Infrastructure failures are signed eval evidence, not training fuel.
Language balance must be visible in summary output before scaling.
does_not_prove: Does not prove an Aider benchmark score; it proves the trace harness can emit eligible corpus rows before a scored campaign.
